scenes.title: The bank account for a household
scenes.sub: Rent, bills and money home in one shared account
scenes.say: This is Vesta. Amina lives in Hackney with her housemates, and sends money home to her mum in Lagos. Today that takes three apps, a spreadsheet in her head, and a lot of chasing. Vesta puts it all in one account the whole house shares.

scenes.title: Sign up with your face
scenes.sub: One Mera passkey. No password, no seed phrase.
scenes.say: She signs up with just her face. No password, no seed phrase, nothing to write down. Her account comes with test money so she can try everything.

scenes.title: Set up the house
scenes.sub: Rent split evenly, invite by private link
scenes.say: She sets up the house. Sixty dollars of rent, split evenly between everyone, and she sends Tobi a private invite link.

scenes.title: Tobi moves in
scenes.sub: His own passkey, straight into the house
scenes.say: Tobi taps the link and moves in with his own passkey. He lands straight in the house, and sees exactly what he owes.

scenes.title: Rent that fills itself
scenes.sub: Everyone pays into one pot on Monad
scenes.say: Both of them pay their share into the rent pot. When it's full, a Chainlink workflow pays the landlord on rent day, and flags anyone who's short before it comes.

scenes.title: Splits without the chasing
scenes.sub: Add it once, settle with a tap
scenes.say: Amina adds last night's dinner to the tab, and Tobi settles up with one tap. Nobody has to chase anybody.

scenes.title: Money home in seconds
scenes.sub: Settled instantly through Agora. No fee.
scenes.say: Then she sends fifty dollars home to Mama. It settles instantly through Agora on Monad, with no fee, and Mama gets a receipt she can open on any phone.

badge.text: Settled instantly by Agora · No fee

scenes.title: A steward that keeps the books
scenes.sub: Answers from the real ledger, indexed by Envio
scenes.say: The steward keeps the books. It reads the house ledger, indexed by Envio, and answers in plain words. It can suggest a payment, but only Amina can make one.

scenes.title: Lose the phone, keep the house
scenes.sub: Wipe everything. Unlock with the passkey. It all comes back.
scenes.say: And if she loses her phone? Wipe everything, unlock with the same passkey, and the whole household comes back. Her keys, her house, her notes. Nothing was stored on a server.

outro.title: Vesta
outro.sub: Money for the people you live with.
outro.say: Vesta. Money for the people you live with.
